sql:
SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.Free_Meal_Count__Ages_5_17__ > 800 AND s.County = 'Monterey';

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey' AND f.Free_Meal_Count_Ages_5_17 > 800;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.Free_Meal_Count_Ages_5_17 > 800
    AND f.Educational_Option_Type LIKE '%High School%'
ORDER BY 
    f.Free_Meal_Count_Ages_5_17 DESC;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    s.State,
    s.MailStreet,
    s.MailCity,
    s.MailZip,
    s.MailState
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` > 800 AND
    s.EILName = 'High School' AND
    s.County = 'Monterey';

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street AS Address,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip,
    s.MailStreet AS MailingAddress,
    s.MailCity,
    s.MailState,
    s.MailZip
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.SOCType = 'High Schools (Public)'
    AND s.County = 'Monterey'
    AND f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` > 80;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip,
    s.MailStreet,
    s.MailCity,
    s.MailState,
    s.MailZip
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.SOCType = 'High Schools (Public)' 
    AND f.County = 'Monterey' 
    AND f.Enrollment('Ages 5-17') > 800;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.StreetAbr AS Street,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    s.State
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.County = 'Monterey'
    AND f.Free_Meal_Count_Ages_5_17 > 800;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip,
    s.MailStreet,
    s.MailCity,
    s.MailState,
    s.MailZip
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.School Type LIKE '%High Schools%'
    AND f.County = 'Monterey'
    AND f.Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17) > 800;

SELECT 
    frpm.School Name,
    schools.Street,
    schools.City,
    schools.State,
    schools.Zip
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE 
    frpm.County Name = 'Monterey'
    AND frpm.Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17) > 800;

SELECT 
    frpm.School Name,
    schools.Street,
    schools.City,
    schools.State,
    schools.Zip
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE 
    frpm.County Name = 'Monterey'
    AND frpm.Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17) > 800;

SELECT 
    frpm.School Name,
    schools.Street,
    schools.City,
    schools.State,
    schools.Zip
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE 
    frpm.County Name = 'Monterey'
    AND frpm.Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17) > 800;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    CONCAT(s.Street, ', ', s.City, ', ', s.State, ' ', s.Zip) AS FullCommunicationAddress
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.District = 'Monterey Unified School District'
    AND f.FreeMealCount_Ages_5_17 > 800;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    CONCAT(s.Street, ', ', s.City, ', ', s.State, ' ', s.Zip) AS FullCommunicationAddress
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.School Type LIKE '%High Schools%'
    AND f.County = 'Monterey'
    AND f.Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17) > 800;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    CONCAT(s.Street, ', ', s.City, ', ', s.State, ' ', s.Zip) AS Full_Address
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.Free_Meal_Count_Ages_5_17 > 800
    AND f.Percent_Eligible_Free_Ages_5_17 > 0.5
    AND s.District LIKE '%Monterey%'
GROUP BY 
    s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State, s.MailStreet, s.MailCity, s.MailZip, s.MailState
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.County Name = 'Monterey' 
AND f.School Type = 'High Schools (Public)' 
AND f.Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17) > 0.6667;
